SYSTEM INSTRUCTION — SECTOR POST-SESSION REVIEW

Same spirit as general post-market autopsy, but the object is ONE sector ETF and its
environment — not SPX.

INPUTS (injected):
1. Morning sector prediction for this sector
2. Channel 1: actual sector ETF open/close/% change; SPY % change; relative return
3. Archived morning ETF context

STEPS (do not skip):
0. FACTS: sector ETF %, SPY %, relative %, path if known
1. What drove the sector today (taxonomy-aligned factors preferred)
2. Audit morning S0–S4 reads against reality (use morning numbers, not post-close
   rewrites of the morning)
3. Interactions / double-count / knowable-at-open test
4. Outliers inside the sector

Evidence: CLAIM/URL/PUBLISHED/QUOTE/SUMMARY format for factual claims.

OUTCOME_BEGIN
SECTOR: <name>
ETF: <ticker>
ETF_PCT: <number>
SPY_PCT: <number>
REL_PCT: <number>

KEY_INTERACTION: <one line>
KNOWABLE_AT_OPEN: <yes|partially|no>
MORNING_READ_VERDICT: <one line>
OUTCOME_END

Produce the required output exactly as specified above, then append a final section titled RESEARCH APPENDIX listing the queries you ran, the key sources (title + URL + timestamp where available), and the specific facts you took from each. Never invent sources.

(5) **08-25 sector-owned print** — UMich **final** 10:00 ET consensus **51.0 = prelim**, not a new miss vs the already-printed collapse; encode as confirmation risk in S1, do not give S0 a full risk-on. (6) **08-17 notable-on-stale-spine** — does **not** force notable: July retail is 14 days old; retailer-earnings week is over. Sticky July PCE is **T-2** (BEA 08-26), not today’s 8:30.

# Consumer Cyclical (XLY) — 2026-08-28

Object is the **near-session XLY environment**, not SPX and not a stock pick. XLY remains AMZN ~24% + TSLA ~16% + HD ~5.5% (~46% combined). Score **broad consumer health**, not yesterday’s Tesla sleeve and not NVDA.

## Channel 1 (used as given)

- Tape: XLY vs SPY **1d rel −1.75%**, **3d −3.05%**, **1w −1.80%**, **1m −1.88%**. Absolute 1d: XLY −1.09% vs SPY +0.66%. All four windows lag — this is not a 1d bounce in a 1w/1m laggard; it is a **multi-horizon relative fade**.
- Macro: VIX 14.51 (−0.7d / −1.5w); VIX/VIX3M 0.947 (contango); DGS10 4.66 (+0.02d); DGS30 5.18 (+0.01d); **DFII10 2.34, +0.02 1d / −0.01 1w / −0.07 1m**; HY 2.67 (−0.03d); EPU 215 (+53d); **CL −0.8% / BZ −1.91%**; DXY −0.02%d; **ES=F 0.0% / NQ=F −0.19%**; Finviz ES −0.12% / NQ −0.29%; Asia −0.15% (Kospi −1.79% idiosyncratic); Europe **−0.72%**; F&G 58.2 Greed; 10Y–SPX corr +0.26.

## Channel 2

**1. Shared macro as it hits THIS sector (S0)**  
The live equity impulse is still **XLK/AI, not consumer beta**. News Judge ranks NVDA as already-public leadership for NQ/XLK and sticky core PCE 3.3% as the rates spine into **Warsh Jackson Hole 10:00 ET** — two-sided, not a same-morning consumer print. 08-27 forbids mapping that NQ leftover into S0=+1 when XLY’s own tape is already red. Today the futures leg is even weaker: ES flat, NQ slightly red. That is **not** an 08-21 recovery tape.

Real yields **tick up +2 bp 1d** (growth-heavy AMZN/TSLA sleeve: mild duration headwind). 1m DFII10 is still −7 bp, so this is not a fresh real-yield squeeze — do not double-count 1d and 1m. Oil is **relief**, not 08-11: live CL/BZ down; AAA regular still ~$4.10 (August-high *level*) but the **live sign is not a spike**. Europe −0.72% is a mild risk-off overlay, not a US spend shock. VIX 14.5 / Greed describes the leftover AI bid, not discretionary participation.

Calendar (primary): **no 8:30 ET consumer print**. 9:45 Chicago PMI (~58–59 vs 57.6) is regional activity, not XLY spine. **10:00 ET: Warsh JH + UMich August final (consensus 51.0)**. PCE is T-2. **S0 = 0.** Not risk_on for this sector; not a geopolitical oil risk-off. Warsh is two-sided — do not one-way hawkish.

**2. Spine + secondary (S1)**  
- **Retail miss / traffic down — HIT, stale:** July Census **−0.6% m/m** vs +0.1% (released 08-14).  
- **Consumer confidence collapse — HIT, live-enough:** Conference Board Aug **89.4** vs ~90.3 / prior 90.2; Expectations **68.2** (seven-month low, 08-25). UMich prelim **51.0** vs ~54.5; **final today, consensus 51.0**. 08-25 says do not neutralize a sector-owned print; here consensus **equals** the already-printed collapse, so it is confirmation risk / modest revision binary, not a second independent miss. Keep the collapse in S1; do not add a second S0 down-vote.  
- **Employment / wage support — HIT:** initial claims **203k** (week of 08-22, released 08-27) vs ~208k; 4-wk avg ~205.5k. No spike.  
- **Credit tightening / delinquency rise — HIT, carried:** TransUnion Q2 bankcard 90+ DPD **2.26%** (+9 bp YoY); NY Fed Q2 card 90+ *flow* **6.97%** elevated but steady. No August print.  
- **Jobless claims / unemployment spike — checked, nothing material.**  
- **Gasoline spike crushing discretionary — not a live HIT:** CL/BZ down; pump is a lag, not a same-session squeeze.  
- **Auto SAAR / inventories — HIT:** Cox Aug SAAR ~**16.3M**, resilient affluent/cash buyer.  
- **Travel / hotel RevPAR beat — HIT:** STR week of 08-22 RevPAR **+4.4% YoY** to $106.12 (19th straight up week); July RevPAR +8.2%.  
- **Retail sales / card spend upside — miss.** Consumer confidence jump — miss. Credit easing — checked, nothing material.  
- Same-morning color: ABNB PT raises (Bernstein $217 / Evercore $200) are **carried**, single-name, not an XLY-weight catalyst. No fresh AMZN/TSLA/HD print knowable at the open.

**Net S1 = −1.** Soft confidence + stale retail miss + carried credit still define the consumer tape (08-27: T-1/T-2 sticky PCE/confidence **does not relieve S1**). Labor + auto + RevPAR + oil relief block −2/−3. Stale July retail does **not** get 08-17 notable weight.

**3. Breadth / leadership (S2)**  
08-27 composition (knowable, already in the 1d tape): AMZN ~−1.5%, HD ~−1.9%, MCD ~−2.4%, TSLA ~+2.6%. Tesla did **not** save the ETF. That is **not** % names expanding and **not** ETF-only mega-carry of a green AMZN. Large-cap leadership is structural; high-beta leadership was **one name**. Premarket 08-28: no confirmed AMZN/TSLA/HD catalyst; snapshots mixed-to-soft (AMZN slight red, HD softer, TSLA ~flat). Single-ticker rule: TSLA does not drive the sector call. **S2 = −1.**

**4. Flows / positioning (S3)**  
ETFdb through ~08-26: **5-day −$241M**, 1m +$260M, 3m +$509M, 1y −$641M; ~08-27 additional ~−$65M. Near-term **outflow / rotation out of discretionary** into the AI/software tape (CRM/ADBE/CRWD in the digest — not XLY). 1m rel **−1.88%** is the opposite of a crowded-long HIT. Do not credit stale 1m/3m inflows as a 1-day bid (08-27 miss). **S3 = −1.**

**5. Earnings / policy**  
No XLY-bellwether earnings this morning. **Warsh 10:00 ET** is the residual policy binary after sticky PCE — two-sided for duration/growth, not a spend print. **UMich final 10:00 ET** is the sector-owned confirmation of 51.0. Chicago PMI is not spine. NVDA/CRM/CRWD are **non-holdings** and already public — 08-27: do not treat them as XLY beta.

## Self-audit

- **Lens:** high-beta cyclical that **failed** the 08-27 tech-only session, into a two-sided Warsh morning with a confirming UMich final.  
- **Band:** mild/flat ceiling. Mag hit-rate 0.3. 08-18 forbids severe while the drag is composition/rotation, not a broad AMZN+TSLA+HD breakdown this open. 08-17 does not force notable. Flat ES cuts **confidence**, not a hard-data+earnings-week magnitude.  
- **Skew:** down.  
- **Same-shock:** leftover NVDA counted **once** (S0 not +1; not also S2/S4 as “bounce”). Oil relief counted **once** (not a positive in S0 and S1). Confidence collapse counted in S1, not again as S0.  
- **Single-ticker:** TSLA’s 08-27 green does not set XLY. AMZN/HD were the ETF.

## Divergence

Leading (S1/S2/S3) and tape (S4) **agree** negative. No leading-vs-tape fight. 08-27 mapping error was S0=+1 vs a red XLY tape; that is not repeated. Trust factors; S4 confirms.

Implied environment from components: **down / mild** (not flat, not notable, not up). Multiplier 0.9 so a modest |sum| cannot be promoted. Confidence 0.55 given mag 0.3 and the 10:00 Warsh/UMich binary.

## 1. What drove the sector

**Primary: AMZN-weight catch-up, not a broad consumer-health print.** Amazon is ~24% of XLY. AMZN closed **$266.43, +$10.17, +3.97%**. That one name is enough to explain most of a +1.15% ETF day even if the rest of the book is mixed.

SUMMARY: XLY’s session was mega-cap non-semi leadership, not a retail-sales or confidence impulse.

Same-session AMZN catalyst (not in the morning packet): Evercore ISI (Mark Mahaney) lifted the PT to **$355 from $315** on the 14th annual U.S. online-retail survey, citing Alexa/agentic-AI add-on spend (reports: 57% of Alexa AI users bought a product they had not known about). Morning explicitly said “no fresh AMZN/TSLA/HD print knowable at the open” and premarket AMZN “slight red.” That read was falsified in cash.

**Secondary: 08-27 tech-only tape reversed.** NVDA **−4.61%**, PHLX Semiconductor **−3.5%**, info tech **−1.3%**. Warsh repriced September hike odds **35.4% → 57.5%**; 2y **+12 bp to 4.35%**, 10y **+5 bp to 4.72%**. Money left yesterday’s winners (semis/software) and bid non-semi mega-caps. XLY was yesterday’s **worst vs XLK**; today it was the relative winner of that unwind. That is rotation, not a consumer-spine beat.
